India and Belgium Expand Defence Cooperation

India and Belgium have agreed to enhance their defence cooperation, focusing on joint industrial production of ammunition and rockets within India. The expanded partnership also includes collaborations on counter-unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS) and robotics. This development signifies a deepening of defence ties between the two nations.
